noir.scope: round circuits (examples/*/circuits, noir/pss_core), read by the co-Noir nodes with the Noir 1.0.0 crates

contract_noir.scope: Aztec contracts and the TXE; aztec-nr v6.0.0 is released for this compiler

postgres.scope: the nodes' Postgres in the e2e (e2e/run.sh reads it here), the CI service containers and the machine's Postgres test fixture (copies that scripts/check-pins.py compares with this one)

total_noir.scope: the total package (flagged primitives) the round circuits and the tip contract library import, as a Nargo git dependency at the tag (cached by nargo under ~/nargo/github.com/iAmMichaelConnor/total-noir/<tag>, which scripts/bootstrap.sh checks is at the commit; every Nargo.toml that takes total names this tag), and total-lint, which scripts/install-toolchain.sh installs from the same commit (cargo install --git) into TOOLS_DIR

schnorr.scope: Schnorr over Grumpkin verified by the tip contracts (result signatures, receipts); a Nargo git dependency, cached by nargo under ~/nargo/github.com/noir-lang/schnorr/v0.4.0

sha256.scope: SHA-256 for total-noir's total package (a Nargo git dependency of it), cached by nargo under ~/nargo/github.com/noir-lang/sha256/v0.3.0

keccak256.scope: Keccak-256 for total-noir's total package (a Nargo git dependency of it), cached by nargo under ~/nargo/github.com/noir-lang/keccak256/v0.1.3

poseidon.scope: Poseidon over BN254 in the machine's registration circuit (machine/circuits/sidecar_register); a Nargo git dependency, cached by nargo under ~/nargo/github.com/noir-lang/poseidon/v0.4.0

crs.scope: the BN254 CRS of the Aztec ceremony that scripts/prepare-data.sh writes to machine/data: g1_sha256 is the sha256 of the first g1_points G1 points (64 bytes each, as crs.aztec-cdn.foundation/g1.dat serves them), g2_sha256 of the G2 point (g2.dat, 128 bytes)

BB_BIN.used_for: verification keys, CRS, contract-side proofs; the binary bb.js 6.0.0 bundles, which e2e/run.sh compares byte for byte

FOUNDRY_DIR.used_for: the e2e only (the @aztec-labs CLI deploys the L1 contracts with it)

patch.why: aztec-nr takes protocol_types from the foundation world beside it rather than a second git copy, so both sides share one type identity
